home.schemeDirectoryTitle: Featured SAMRIDDHI Concessional Credit Schemes (5,000+ Database)
home.howItWorksTitle: How the SAMRIDDHI Unified Portal Works
home.howItWorksDesc: From guided intake to bank channel dispatch in 4 seamless stages.
home.step1Desc: Speak or fill your project cost, caste category, and income. Illiteracy-assisted voice parsing supported.
home.step2Desc: Upload your Community Certificate. Pytesseract engine verifies category status in real time.
home.step3Desc: Geodesic router evaluates local bank branches and ranks them by composite R_score index.
home.step4Desc: Selected SCA or PSB branch completes field sign-off and disburses concessional credit directly via DBT.
home.partnerNetworkTitle: 1,840+ Active SCAs, Public Sector Banks & Regional Rural Banks
home.partnerNetworkDesc: SAMRIDDHI capital is routed directly through State Channelising Agencies, Public Sector Banks (SBI, UBI, Canara Bank, PNB), and Regional Rural Banks.

schemes.heading: Official SAMRIDDHI Concessional Loan Schemes & Rules (5,000+ Schemes)
schemes.subheading: Unified statutory repository across Central Ministries, State Welfare Departments, and Apex Corporations.
schemes.gate1Desc: Annual family income must not exceed ₹ 5,00,000 to ₹ 8,00,000 depending on statutory scheme.
schemes.gate2Desc: Eligible for SC, ST, OBC, EWS, DNT, PwD, and Minorities with valid Revenue Dept Certificate.
schemes.gate3Desc: Female beneficiaries receive subsidized rates starting from 3.5% - 5.0% across schemes.
schemes.directoryTitle: SAMRIDDHI National Welfare & Concessional Scheme Directory (5,000+ Schemes)
schemes.directoryDesc: Explore 5,050+ statutory schemes spanning 36 States/UTs, 20 Central Ministries, and 18 Affirmative Caste & Minority classifications (NSFDC, NSTFDC, NBCFDC, NMDFC, NHFDC). Click any scheme to flip card and view required documents.
schemes.rulesAlertTitle: Statutory Eligibility Gates for All 5,000+ SAMRIDDHI Schemes
schemes.rule1Desc: Applicant must belong to eligible category (SC, ST, OBC, EWS, DNT, PwD, Minorities) with valid certificate.
schemes.rule2Desc: Annual family income must meet the respective scheme threshold across rural and urban territories.
schemes.rule3Desc: Female entrepreneurs receive maximum subsidized rates; standard rates apply to other applicants.
schemes.searchPlaceholder: Search across 5,000+ schemes by keyword, caste/category, ministry, state, or sector...
schemes.noSchemesDesc: Try adjusting your search query, selecting 'All India', or resetting category filters.

NSFDC_MCF.title: Micro Credit Finance Scheme (MCF)
NSFDC_MCF.description: Direct micro-credit loans for small business, vending, artisans, and rural micro-enterprises.

NSFDC_MSY.title: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (MSY)
NSFDC_MSY.description: Specialized concessional loan for Scheduled Caste female entrepreneurs with maximum government share.

NSFDC_TL.title: Term Loan Scheme (General)
NSFDC_TL.description: Capital expenditure financing for commercial transport, manufacturing, and agro-processing units.

NSFDC_ELS_D.title: Educational Loan Scheme (Domestic)
NSFDC_ELS_D.description: Higher professional education financing in India (Engineering, Medicine, Law, Management).

NSFDC_ELS_O.title: Overseas Educational Loan Scheme
NSFDC_ELS_O.description: Concessional credit for post-graduate and doctoral studies in foreign universities.

NSFDC_GBS.title: Green Business Scheme (GBS)
NSFDC_GBS.description: Financial assistance for eco-friendly business activities (Battery Rickshaws, Solar Energy, Waste Mgmt).

NSFDC_SWSS.title: Sanitation Workers Special Scheme
NSFDC_SWSS.description: Concessional credit for sanitation workers and liberated manual scavengers for alternative dignified livelihoods.

NSFDC_SKYS.title: Shilpi Samriddhi Yojana (Artisan Scheme)
NSFDC_SKYS.description: Subsidized term loan assistance for traditional SC artisans, handicrafts, and handloom weavers.

NSFDC_VBS.title: Vending & Micro Business Scheme
NSFDC_VBS.description: Working capital financing for urban street vendors, hawkers, and weekly market traders.

NSFDC_DAIRY.title: Dairy & Animal Husbandry Scheme
NSFDC_DAIRY.description: Concessional loans for milch cattle purchase, poultry farming, goat rearing, and milk chilling infrastructure.

schemes.note_moratorium: Moratorium grace period is provided before EMI commences.

intake.title: Citizen Concessional Credit Intake (Step 1 of 4)
intake.subtitle: Please answer all 11 statutory eligibility questions below on this single page. You can click 🔊 to listen to any question in your selected language or click 🎙️ on any answer field to speak your response.
intake.q1_title: 1. Enter your Full Legal Name and 10-Digit Mobile Number
intake.q1_desc: Please provide your official legal name as per government records and your active 10-digit Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
intake.namePlaceholder: Enter your full legal name as per official records
intake.genderLabel: Applicant Gender (Determines Special Women Interest Concession)
intake.q2_title: 2. Enter your Age / Date of Birth
intake.q2_desc: Select your birth date using the calendar or enter your age directly.
intake.q3_desc: Select the Indian State or Union Territory where the project/business will operate.
intake.q4_desc: Select the district for local State Channelizing Agency (SCA) or Bank Branch routing.
intake.q5_desc: Detect your exact GPS location or enter your village/town address and 6-digit postal PIN code.
intake.addressPlaceholder: Enter local street, village or town address
intake.q6_title: 6. Select your Caste / Affirmative Action Category
intake.q6_desc: SAMRIDDHI portal supports all communities (SC, ST, OBC, EWS, GEN, DNT, PwD, and Minorities) matching 5,000+ statutory schemes.
intake.scWarning: ⚠️ Affirmative Category Note: Schemes are matched based on your selected community (SC, ST, OBC, EWS, DNT, PwD, Minorities) as per Government of India statutory guidelines.
intake.q7_desc: Select your highest completed educational level. If not listed, select 'Other' and specify.
intake.q8_desc: Enter total annual family income from all sources. Statutory gate ceiling is typically ₹ 5,00,000 / year.
intake.incomeWarning: ⚠️ Alert: Annual income exceeds ₹ 5,00,000 limit. Some specialized schemes may have relaxed ceilings.
intake.q9_title: 9. What type of assistance are you looking for?
intake.q9_desc: Select the primary category of financial assistance or scheme purpose you require.
intake.subBusinessDesc: Select your trade activity to match sector-specific concessional guidelines.
intake.q10_title: 10. Do you already have any existing loan for this project?
intake.q10_desc: Disclose any prior or existing institutional credit availed for the current enterprise.
intake.yesLoan: Yes, I have an existing loan
intake.noLoan: No, this is a fresh loan application
intake.q11_desc: Enter the total capital cost required. Concessional credit finances up to 90% - 95% with 5% - 10% beneficiary margin.
intake.proceedStep2: Proceed to Step 2: Certificate OCR Verification →
intake.validationAlert: Please complete all mandatory fields (Name, 10-digit Phone, State, District, Category, Income, and Cost) to continue.
intake.phoneError: Mobile number must be exactly 10 numeric digits
